assumptions: The card's 9,373,856,662-byte target was treated as approximate: the authoritative figures are the HF tree manifest, which the on-disk files match byte-for-byte and whose LFS sha256 the local sha256sum reproduces. No retry was triggered by the size difference because integrity was proven by digest, not by size.

Verification of loadability was inferred from checkpoint layout + the container's sglang source + GPU compute capability, not from a live load. No container was started, stopped or restarted and no model requests were made, per unit constraints; demonstrating that the weights actually load is deferred to a separate unit.
docker exec was used for read-only introspection (python imports, source reads, file lists) of the already-running gx10-occamy-nvfp4 container. No state was modified.
Host python3 has no sglang, so the target of the go verdict is the container image, not the bare host.
